import unicodedata

AP = "\u2019"  # the apostrophe used in the Listuguj orthography

EXAMPLES = [
    ("tmi" + AP + "gn", "dəmīgən", "axe"),
    ("an" + AP + "stawteg", "anəstawtek", "unsafe"),
    ("gjiansale" + AP + "wit", "əkciansalēwit", "archangel"),
    ("mgumie" + AP + "jo" + AP + "tlatl", "əmkumiējōdəladəl", "to shoe (a horse)"),
    ("amqwanji" + AP + "j", "amxʷancīc", "spoon"),
    ("e" + AP + "jnt", "ējənt", "Indian agent"),
    ("tplutaqan", "ətpəludaɣan", "law"),
    ("ge" + AP + "gwising", "gēgʷisink", "to lie on the top"),
    ("lnu" + AP + "sgw", "lənūskw", "Indian woman"),
    ("g" + AP + "p" + AP + "ta" + AP + "q", "gəbədāx", "above, overhead"),
    ("epsaqtejg", "epsaxteck", "stove"),
]

TARGET_PHON = "alaptək"
SUBMITTED = "alapt" + AP + "k"


def inventory(examples):
    letters = set()
    for orth, _, _ in examples:
        for ch in orth:
            if ch != AP:
                letters.add(ch)
    return letters


def forward(orth):
    # Rule set taken from the attested examples:
    #   apostrophe -> schwa (an'stawteg -> anəstawtek)
    #   word-final g -> k   (an'stawteg, epsaqtejg)
    out = []
    for i, ch in enumerate(orth):
        if ch == AP:
            out.append("ə")
        elif ch == "g" and i == len(orth) - 1:
            out.append("k")
        else:
            out.append(ch)
    return "".join(out)


inv = inventory(EXAMPLES)
print("Orthographic inventory:", "".join(sorted(inv)))
print("'k' attested in examples:", "k" in inv)

# Calibrate rules on the one example that exercises both rules.
calib_orth, calib_phon, _ = EXAMPLES[1]
calib_ok = forward(calib_orth) == calib_phon
print("Calibration", calib_orth, "->", forward(calib_orth), "expected", calib_phon,
      "CHECK PASS" if calib_ok else "CHECK FAIL")

# Enumerate candidate spellings for the target: final [k] may be spelled g or k.
candidates = ["alapt" + AP + "g", "alapt" + AP + "k"]
results = {}
for cand in candidates:
    phon = forward(cand)
    phon_match = phon == TARGET_PHON
    uses_attested = all(ch in inv or ch == AP for ch in cand)
    results[cand] = (phon, phon_match, uses_attested)
    print("Candidate", cand, "-> phonetic", phon, "| matches target:", phon_match,
          "| letters attested:", uses_attested)

submitted_phon, submitted_match, submitted_attested = results[SUBMITTED]
print("Submitted answer:", SUBMITTED)
print("Submitted phonetic:", submitted_phon, "target:", TARGET_PHON)

if submitted_match and submitted_attested:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif submitted_match and not submitted_attested:
    print("Submitted spelling reproduces the phonetics but uses 'k', which never appears in the orthography;")
    print("attested convention writes [k] as g (an'stawteg -> anəstawtek, epsaqtejg -> epsaxteck).")
    print("Expected spelling under attested rules:", "alapt" + AP + "g")
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("CHECK FAIL")

print("Note: rule set is derived from 11 examples; a sample-based check, not a proof of the full orthography.")
